written: 2026-11-03, before the first v6 GPU job
data: val fold 0 of data/splits/split_v1.csv (1408 images); default 23-variant suite for the rules, extended suite reported only

adopt_if: mean clean AUC over the 2 seeds >= reference mean clean + 0.003 (>= 0.909525)
mean worst-of-23 AUC over the 2 seeds >= reference mean worst + 0.003 (>= 0.90315)
no seed below the reference minimum on clean or worst
screen_rule.backbones: S2 archs are adopted per arch under the same rule; the final members are the best adopted CNN and the best adopted transformer by mean of (clean + worst)/2, falling back to convnext_small and swin_t

switch_rule.reference: shipped = final_resnet50 + e_cnxt_small + final_swin_t, equal-weight mean_logit, views orig+flip
switch_rule.candidate: final design simulated on fold 0: 4 inner-fold models per member (trained on folds 1-4 via split_v1_h0_v{j}), equal-weight mean_logit
switch_rule.bootstrap: paired, 1000 reps over val images, seed 0
pass_if: 95% CI lower bound > -0.002 for both gains
T4 estimate for 3000 images < 200 s, confirmed on a Kaggle T4 (hard cap 240 s)
switch_rule.fallback: shipped trio + inner-fold members, scored once under the same rule; if it also fails, ship unchanged and report v6 as a negative result
